summary: Consolidated and independently verified PR 879's narrow parser correction. Clean schema-disambiguated arguments/args envelopes, including JSON-string and repeated wrappers, fail before and normalize after in one-shot and streaming paths. PR 941's remaining examples do not justify further source mutation: corrupted command content is not reconstructable; valid outer wrappers can be peeled but invalid inner JSON cannot be decoded into tool arguments; and schemas without declared top-level properties do not disambiguate an envelope from a legitimate free-form argument key.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base one-shot and three-character streaming output: clean quadruple wrapping remained unchanged; corruption and schema-ambiguous boundaries were also preserved. See raw/base-counterexamples.txt.

At the exact candidate, clean quadruple wrapping normalized in one-shot and streaming; duplicated command text, damaged JSON strings, and schemas without declared properties were preserved. See raw/candidate-counterexamples.txt.
Focused detector regression suite, including clean quadruple repair and explicit irrecoverable/schema-ambiguous boundaries.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 was visible and inventoried in raw/gpu-inventory.txt. No GPU execution was relevant to the deterministic Python parser correction, and the named model weights were unavailable.

remaining_limitations: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp weights were unavailable, so generation frequency, vision/model semantics, mid-stream generation corruption, and the error-feedback escalation loop were not reproduced end to end.
Inner command duplication or corruption cannot be reconstructed from the malformed emitted payload alone.
Syntactically invalid inner JSON strings cannot be normalized without guessing at intended content.
Schemas without usable declared top-level properties cannot safely disambiguate a model-added envelope from a legitimate free-form arguments key.
The tiny Llama fixture is a different architecture and was not used as substitute evidence.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; no multi-GPU or distributed behavior was tested.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
